what_it_does: This paper extends MPI (Message Passing Interface, a standard for parallel computing communication) correctness testing to Fortran. MPI is used by scientists and engineers to write programs that run across multiple computers. While test suites exist to catch bugs in MPI implementations for C, none existed for Fortran despite the standard supporting both languages. This work ports the most recent MPI test suite (MPI-BugBench) to Fortran and evaluates how well correctness-checking tools work on Fortran MPI code.
